g.text: Synthetic 16 × 16 patches rendered from height maps with Lambertian shading; network 256–64–32–3 (ReLU, numpy, Adam) trained on 9 000 patches with the Sun from the
west (azimuth 150–210°, elevation 20–45°) and noise 0.02. Each bar or point: 1 200 new test patches. Seeds fixed.
